subject: Television & Streaming
title: Have Gun—Will Travel
description: A fast breakdown of Have Gun—Will Travel for builders.

hook.text: Paladin was a gunfighter who quoted Shakespeare, ate gourmet food, and solved problems with his mind first.

buildup.text: Have Gun—Will Travel made its hero a cultured intellectual in a genre full of simple cowboys and outlaws.

discovery.text: The show proved that westerns could be smart. Writers used frontier settings to explore philosophy and ethics.

twist.text: Richard Boone, who played Paladin, insisted on complex scripts. He rejected any story he found predictable.

climax.text: The show ran five seasons and inspired morally complex TV antiheroes decades before Tony Soprano.

punchline.text: The smartest man on 1950s TV was a gunslinger.

quiz.question: What made Paladin unusual among TV western heroes?
options: He was a cultured intellectual who preferred brains over bullets
